queries.query: Our React dashboard now has the same KPI tile markup on three pages, with compact and regular densities and one page needing a richer footer. Review the nearby MetricTile component and decide whether to reuse it, add variants or slots, or introduce a separate component without pulling page analytics and routing into it.

Please review this FilterPanel refactor. Callers are passing six boolean props and custom class overrides to represent density, tone, loading, and optional rich actions. Recommend a clearer reusable component API and explain what should remain owned by each page.
Audit our light and dark theme tokens for color contrast, spacing consistency, and semantic naming, then propose a revised token scale. The component structure and APIs should remain unchanged.

Use browser screenshots at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths to verify the existing checkout page has no clipping, overlap, or unexpected visual regressions, and report the viewport-specific issues you find.
